PRICE.Q: How much does a 3D model cost?
PRICE.A: Depends on complexity: a low-poly object from €90, detailed hard-surface from €250, a rigged character from €600. The calculator above gives a ballpark; the exact price comes after the brief.

TIME.A: A simple object — 3–5 days, a product model — 1–2 weeks, a character or scene — 2–4 weeks. The first concept lands within 48 hours.

FORMATS.A: GLB/GLTF, FBX, OBJ, STL, BLEND — plus texture sources. For the web we optimize further: Draco compression, KTX2 textures.

EDITS.A: Three revision rounds are included. We show progress every couple of days, so revisions stay small and fast.

RIGHTS.A: You do. After payment you get full commercial royalty-free rights. Catalog models can be used in any project.

SECTIONS.TITLE: General Provisions
SECTIONS.BODY: This document is a public offer — a proposal to enter into an agreement for the sale of digital goods and the provision of 3D modeling services on the terms set out below. The contractor is the FORMA³ studio (legal status of the contractor: self-employed or sole proprietor — to be specified). Placing an order on the website or making a payment constitutes full and unconditional acceptance of this offer.

SECTIONS.TITLE: Subject of the Offer
SECTIONS.BODY: The contractor sells ready-made digital 3D models from the website catalog and provides custom 3D modeling services (characters, hard-surface, product visualization, models for WebGL, AR/VR and 3D printing). All goods are digital: no physical delivery is performed.

SECTIONS.TITLE: Ordering Process
SECTIONS.BODY: Ready-made models are purchased through the website cart. Custom work is ordered via the request form: the client describes the task, the contractor clarifies the details through the provided contacts and agrees on the scope, timeline and price. Work on a custom order starts after the terms are confirmed and paid for, unless the parties agree otherwise.

SECTIONS.TITLE: Payment
SECTIONS.BODY: Prices are listed in the catalog on product pages; the cost of custom work is agreed individually. Payment is made online through a payment provider (Stripe). The contractor does not receive or store card details — they are processed by the payment provider. The moment of successful payment is considered acceptance of the offer for the specific order.

SECTIONS.TITLE: File Delivery
SECTIONS.BODY: Files of purchased models (GLB, FBX, OBJ and other agreed formats) are sent to the email address provided at checkout after the payment is confirmed. If the email does not arrive, the client may request a re-send via the contact email. For custom work, files are delivered as the agreed milestones are accepted.

SECTIONS.TITLE: Model License
SECTIONS.BODY: From the moment the files are delivered, the client receives a non-exclusive, perpetual, royalty-free commercial license: the model may be used in games, advertising, visualizations, applications and other projects, including commercial ones. It is prohibited to resell, rent out or distribute the model files themselves (in original or modified form) as a standalone product, or to present the model as one's own work. Exclusive rights to the model remain with the contractor unless otherwise agreed in a contract.

SECTIONS.TITLE: Liability and Disputes
SECTIONS.BODY: The contractor is responsible for the delivered files matching the product description or the agreed brief. The contractor is not liable for the inability to use a model due to limitations of the client's software or platforms. Claims should be sent to hello@forma3d.studio and are reviewed within 10 business days; the parties strive to resolve disputes through negotiation.

SECTIONS.TITLE: Disclaimer
SECTIONS.BODY: This document is a template prepared for demonstration purposes. Before being used in real commercial activity, the text must be reviewed and adapted by a lawyer, taking into account the contractor's legal status and the applicable law.

SECTIONS.TITLE: General Provisions
SECTIONS.BODY: This policy describes what personal data the FORMA³ studio (the contractor) collects, what it is used for and how it is protected. By using the website and placing orders, you agree to the terms of this policy.

SECTIONS.TITLE: What Data We Collect
SECTIONS.BODY: When placing an order, we collect: name, email address and a contact for communication (phone or messenger), as well as the order contents and comments. Card details are not collected or stored by the contractor — payments are processed by the payment provider.

SECTIONS.TITLE: Purposes of Processing
SECTIONS.BODY: The data is used solely for order processing: contacting the client, clarifying details, sending the files of purchased models by email and informing about the order status. No marketing emails are sent and no data is shared for advertising.

SECTIONS.TITLE: Storage and Sharing
SECTIONS.BODY: Order data is stored in an SQLite database on the contractor's server. Data is not shared with third parties, except for the payment provider (Stripe) — to the extent necessary to process the payment. Only the contractor has access to the data through a protected admin panel.

SECTIONS.TITLE: Cookies and Local Data
SECTIONS.BODY: The website uses cookies and browser local storage to a minimal extent: the selected interface language, the cart contents and the administrator session (site owner only). No advertising or third-party analytics trackers are used.

SECTIONS.TITLE: Your Rights
SECTIONS.BODY: You may request information about your data, its correction or deletion. To do so, write to hello@forma3d.studio from the address provided at checkout. Requests are processed within 10 business days; deletion is possible if the data is not required to fulfill an already paid order.

SECTIONS.TITLE: Disclaimer
SECTIONS.BODY: This document is a template prepared for demonstration purposes. Before being used in real activity, the text must be reviewed and adapted by a lawyer, taking into account the applicable personal data legislation.

SECTIONS.TITLE: General Provisions
SECTIONS.BODY: This policy describes the refund terms for digital goods and 3D modeling services of the FORMA³ studio. By placing an order, you agree to the terms set out below.

SECTIONS.TITLE: Ready-Made Digital Goods
SECTIONS.BODY: A refund for a ready-made model from the catalog is possible until the files are sent to your email. After the files have been delivered, no refund is provided, since a digital product cannot be returned — except when the files are technically unusable and could not be replaced.

SECTIONS.TITLE: Custom Work
SECTIONS.BODY: Work on an order is divided into agreed milestones (brief, concept, modeling, finalization). Before work starts, the full amount is refunded. After work has started, the refund is calculated proportionally: the cost of the milestones already completed and accepted is withheld, and the remainder is returned.

SECTIONS.TITLE: Technical Issues with Files
SECTIONS.BODY: If the received files are corrupted, do not open, or do not match the product description or the agreed brief, contact us within 14 days of receipt. We will replace the files or fix the model; if that is not possible, we will refund the payment in full.

SECTIONS.TITLE: How to Request a Refund
SECTIONS.BODY: To request a refund, send a message to hello@forma3d.studio from the address used for the order: include the order number or contents and the reason. Requests are reviewed within 10 business days. Refunds are issued via the same payment method used for the purchase; the crediting time depends on the payment provider and the bank.

SECTIONS.TITLE: Contact for Claims
SECTIONS.BODY: All claims regarding orders, files and refunds are accepted at hello@forma3d.studio. We respond to requests in order of receipt and strive to resolve issues through negotiation.
